identity.description: An unsigned process creates a scheduled task and injects code into a running process, mimicking a malicious persistence and execution technique. Cortex should detect the unsigned process, scheduled task creation, and injection behavior.

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process starts with hidden window

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unsigned Process Created Scheduled Task
biocs.description: Detection of unsigned process creating a scheduled task
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'schtasks.exe'
| filter actor_process_signing_status = ENUM.UNSIGNED
